summary: Exposed knife on the island edge and a runner rug without non-slip backing create injury and trip risks.

hazards.title: Unsecured Chef Knife on Counter
hazards.detail: Large knife sits exposed near island edge, posing a severe cut risk if bumped.
fixSteps: Store the knife in a designated knife block or protective drawer tray.
Move sharp cutlery away from the perimeter of kitchen islands.

hazards.title: Curled Kitchen Runner Rug
hazards.detail: Accent rug in main walkway has loose edges, creating an active tripping hazard.
fixSteps: Apply heavy-duty rug tape or install a rubber non-skid pad underneath.
Ensure all rug edges lie flat against the hardwood flooring.

hazards.title: Towel Hanging on Oven Handle
hazards.detail: Cloth hanging near the oven door could ignite if elements are turned on carelessly.
fixSteps: Relocate kitchen towels to a wall-mounted hook away from cook surface…
Keep all fabric and paper goods away from oven vents and ranges.

hazards.title: Combustible Paper Near Sink and Cook
hazards.detail: Paper towel roll placed closely along cooking perimeter poses a slight fire risk.
fixSteps: Mount paper towels under the upper cabinet away from cooktops.
Maintain clear work zones on counters around cooking surfaces.

products.name: In-Drawer Bamboo Knife Block
products.reason: Safely stores sharp knives inside drawers to prevent accidental cuts.

products.name: Non-Slip Rug Grippers
products.reason: Anchors runner corners flat to eliminate curling and tripping hazards.
